attempts.raw_response: The extreme conditions of the Karakoram range during winter make this feat particularly daunting. Temperatures plummet well below freezing, and violent storms can rage for days without warning, creating a hostile environment that few dare to challenge. The successful ascent by Purja’s team not only highlights their exceptional physical endurance but also underscores the strategic precision required to navigate such perilous terrain. This achievement serves as a testament to human resilience, inspiring future generations of climbers to push beyond perceived boundaries. As the dust settles on this historic moment, the world watches in awe, recognizing that even the most formidable peaks can be conquered through unity and unwavering determination against nature’s harshest elements.

pair.human_continuation: Until now, none has reached higher than 7,650 metres. Nepali guides, usually ethnic Sherpas, are considered the backbone of the climbing industry around the Himalayas, and regularly help foreign mountaineers on expeditions. News of the group's success on Saturday has been praised on social media and sparked joy within the Nepalese climbing community - often left out of the spotlight. "For decades, Nepalis have assisted foreigners to reach the summits of the Himalayas, but we've not been getting the recognition we deserve," said Kami Rita, speaking to AFP. "It is wonderful that today on K2 10 Nepalis have made history and shown our bravery and strength," added Mr Rita, who has climbed Everest a record 24 times.
pair.prefix: Mountaineer Nirmal Purja - a former member of the UK's Special Boat Service - shared an image of the group celebrating their achievement, which was confirmed by expedition organiser Seven Summit Treks. "We are proud to have been a part of history for humankind and to show that collaboration, teamwork and a positive mental attitude can push limits to what we feel might be possible," said Mr Purja. Since the first attempt in 1987-1988, just a handful of winter expeditions have been attempted on K2.

source_document.title: Nepali climbers make history with winter summit of K2 mountain
